findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_capsule, turn, account_bind · Private data: find_capsule, browse_catalog, open_journey, turn, journey_state, make_artifact, handoff, restart_journey, account_bind, account_verify · Public sink: find_capsule, browse_catalog, open_journey, turn, journey_state, make_artifact, handoff, restart_journey, account_bind, account_verify · Destructive: account_bind.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_capsule, turn, account_bind · Private data: find_capsule, browse_catalog, open_journey, turn, journey_state, make_artifact, handoff, restart_journey, account_bind, account_verify · Public sink: find_capsule, browse_catalog, open_journey, turn, journey_state, make_artifact, handoff, restart_journey, account_bind, account_verify · Destructive: account_bind

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "find_capsule" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
